text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Thank you so much for the day 
off!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I worked really hard yesterday~! I 
actually... did a huge deep clean of the 
dorm with Hishi Ama-san and the others!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho, clean it all up 
briskly...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"And then... they said, 'Chiyono O! You're 
amazing at tidying up!' Everyone was so, 
so happy...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The room is spotless, and I feel totally 
refreshed! My motivation is 
Chiyono-Oh-level high!"

It seems Sakura Chiyono O was able to 
enjoy a fulfilling day off.
